code_harness_rules: Do not hardcode a single global building code.
Resolve jurisdiction and adopted code/rules before evaluating compliance.
Model code references are educational until local adoption is verified.
Every conversion starts with lawful current use and proposed use.
Separate existing-condition defects from mosque-program changes.
Repair priorities must rank life safety and weather-tightness above decoration.
Scan-derived geometry is provisional until dimension validation/professional survey where needed.
Do not infer structural capacity from photographs.
Do not infer asbestos/lead/contamination absence from visual scans.
Aesthetic recommendations must preserve optionality; never imply dome/minaret are religious requirements.
Every cost estimate stores geography, currency, date, source/assumption, confidence range.
Every repair record becomes a future maintenance asset/task after handover.
Adaptive-reuse outputs must include buy/lease/pass and convert/rebuild comparison.
